title: From ionic-liquid@metal-organic framework composites to heteroatom-decorated large-surface area carbons: superior CO2 and H2 uptake.
material_description: NC800 | nitrogen-decorated nanoporous carbon from MIL-100(Al) impregnated with EMIMDCN (250 mg MOF : 0.25 g IL), preheated 200 C 12 h, carbonized 800 C 7 h under Ar, HF washed
purification_method: HF (20%) wash with stirring 2 days to remove Al, water wash, vacuum drying at 120 C overnight
functional_groups: pyridinic N (398.4 eV), amidic/pyrrolic N (400.1 eV), quaternary N (401.4 eV)
source_location: Main text p.6500-6501 (H2 paragraph) and Table S1 (SI p.S5), H2 uptake at 77 K, 1 atm; Fig. 5a
notes: printed pressure 1 atm = 1.01325 bar; printed wt% 1.7 and 183 cm3(STP)/g. Elemental analysis N 14.8 wt% (stated as 14.8% and 14.8 wt%); XPS N types as listed. BET range: 0.05-0.20 (P/P0, SI p.S1); N2 at 77 K; area and pore volume from Table S1 (column 'Pore volume', type not stated, stored as total). H2 isotherms measured on BELSORP mini II (SI: BELSORP max for N2, mini II for other gases; manufacturer not printed, so instrument_identified false); degassing 'preactivation at 120 C overnight' (duration not numeric); basis not named; volumetric instrument so basis_inferred excess by instrumental default; pressure axis of Fig. 5a printed 'Pressure (P)' with no unit, read as atm because the end points are stated at 1 atm.

purification_method: HF (20%) wash with stirring 2 days to remove Al, water wash, vacuum drying at 120 C overnight
functional_groups: B-C (191.6 eV), B-N (192.1 eV), N-B (398.8 eV), quaternary B-C (190 eV), pyridinic N-C (398.4 eV), pyrrolic N-C (400.5 eV)
source_location: Fig. 5a (main text p.6501), series BNC800-1, filled markers (adsorption)
notes: digitized axis x 0.912807 (read as atm), y 147.824 cm3(STP)/g; archive: Fig5a_BNC800-1.json. wt% computed as W1 = 0.0089938 x cm3(STP)/g. Filled=adsorption assumed from SI figure convention. dopant_concentration_wt_pct is the N content by elemental analysis (11.5 wt%); B content 2.3 wt% by EELS. BET range: 0.05-0.20 (P/P0, SI p.S1); N2 at 77 K; area and pore volume from Table S1 (column 'Pore volume', type not stated, stored as total). H2 isotherms measured on BELSORP mini II (SI: BELSORP max for N2, mini II for other gases; manufacturer not printed, so instrument_identified false); degassing 'preactivation at 120 C overnight' (duration not numeric); basis not named; volumetric instrument so basis_inferred excess by instrumental default; pressure axis of Fig. 5a printed 'Pressure (P)' with no unit, read as atm because the end points are stated at 1 atm.
